validate_input_array: validate input data by converting it to a numpy array with optional sparse, dtype, and finiteness checks
validate_X_and_y: validate both feature matrix X and target vector y for consistent sample counts and proper shapes
check_estimator_fitted: check if a scikit-learn estimator has been fitted by verifying presence of underscored attributes
create_random_state: convert a seed value into a numpy RandomState instance for reproducible random number generation
validate_scalar_parameter: validate a scalar parameter's type and value against minimum and maximum bounds with configurable boundary inclusion
